context: Daichi and Kenji talk about advertising a new house.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: marketing chat; ad vocabulary (広告/住宅/メーカー/建築/ドア) in natural home.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 新しい住宅の広告、作りたいんよ。
lines.en: I want to make an ad for the new housing.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 広告には、建築の写真がいいですね。
lines.en: For the ad, photos of the construction would be good.
lines.style: helpful office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: メーカーのこだわりを、見せたいんや。
lines.en: I want to show the maker's craftsmanship.
lines.style: enthusiastic Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 玄関のドアを、大きく載せましょう。
lines.en: Let's feature the entrance door prominently.
lines.style: clear office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ええな、ドアは住宅の顔やからな。
lines.en: Nice, the door is the face of the house.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 広告に、建築の特徴も書きましょう。
lines.en: Let's write the construction's features in the ad.
lines.style: measured office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: このメーカーの良さが、伝わるとええな。
lines.en: I hope this maker's quality comes across.
lines.style: warm Kansai man voice, warm hopeful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 良い広告で、住宅が映えますよ。
lines.en: A good ad makes the housing shine.
lines.style: reassuring office man voice, soft warm closing throughout
